_readme.purpose: Source-backed data for the import payments on a passenger car (EAEU HS heading 8703) brought into Armenia: customs duty or the personal-use unified payment, VAT, excise, environmental tax and customs fees.
_readme.value_format: Same as src/data/salary-tax.json: every rule is a sourced value {value, unit, applies_to, effective_from, effective_to, source_url, source_name, evidence (original-language quote), evidence_en, last_verified, conflict, conflicting_sources, cross_checks, unsure, unsure_reason}. `calculation_parameters` holds the same numbers as plain values for src/lib/car-customs.ts; tests/car-customs.test.ts checks they agree.
_readme.logic: docs/car-customs-logic.md explains the formula in plain words.
rules: No value in this file was written from memory. Each one was read from the page named in source_url during the 2026-10-26 research session.

Primary sources: the EEC tariff and decisions, the RA Tax Code, Law on State Duty and Law on Customs Regulation on arlis.am, and the SRC (src.am, exim.src.am). Brokers, news and forums appear only in cross_checks and real_world_examples.
The SRC's own calculator (exim.src.am/transport) was run on 19 inputs on 2026-10-26; the formula reproduces every one to the dram. See official_calculator_cross_check.
Values with unsure=true must be re-checked before production use. See _open_questions.
_readme.warning: ADVISORY DATA, NOT CUSTOMS ADVICE. The customs value itself is set by the SRC, which may not accept the declared price. Re-verify before relying on this.

calculation_parameters._note: Plain numbers used by src/lib/car-customs.ts. Each mirrors a sourced value elsewhere in this file; tests/car-customs.test.ts asserts they agree. Upper bounds are inclusive ('не превышает'); null means open-ended.

personal_use.value: unified payment (duty and VAT together) + environmental tax
personal_use.applies_to: individuals importing a petrol, diesel or hybrid car (8703, except pure electric 8703 80) for personal use from a non-EAEU country
personal_use.source_name: RA State Revenue Committee (SRC), FAQ on customs clearance of cars, 13.12.2023 (Armenian original https://www.src.am/am/getNews/299)
personal_use.evidence: При таможенном оформлении легковых автомобилей, ввозимых физическими лицами, взимается единовременный таможенный сбор (независимо от возраста автомобиля)и экологический налог
personal_use.evidence_en: When clearing passenger cars imported by individuals, a one-time customs payment (whatever the car's age) and the environmental tax are charged.

commercial.evidence_en: For goods released for domestic consumption the VAT base is the customs value plus the customs duty (plus excise for excisable goods).

electric_personal.value: aggregate customs payment = tariff duty + VAT (not the unified rate)
electric_personal.applies_to: individuals importing a pure electric car (8703 80 000) for personal use
electric_personal.source_name: EEC Council Decision No. 107 of 20.12.2017, Annex 2, Table 2, item 3 (reprint on zakon.uchet.kz, consolidated to 24.02.2026), items 3 and 4
electric_personal.evidence: 3. Автомобили легковые … классифицируемые в товарной позиции 8703 ТН ВЭД ЕАЭС (за исключением транспортных средств, указанных в пунктах 1 и 4 настоящей таблицы) … 4. Автомобили легковые … содержащие в качестве ходовых исключительно электродвигатели … 8703 80 000 ТН ВЭД ЕАЭС — в виде совокупного таможенного платежа
electric_personal.evidence_en: Item 3 (unified rates) excludes item 4; pure electric cars pay an aggregate customs payment, which by EAEU Customs Code Art. 266(16) is the sum of the duty and the taxes computed separately.

up_to_3_years.unit: percent of the car's value, but not less than EUR per cm³ of engine volume (the larger of the two)
up_to_3_years.applies_to: personal-use cars no more than 3 years old
up_to_3_years.source_name: EEC Council Decision No. 107 of 20.12.2017, Annex 2, Table 2, item 3 (reprint on zakon.uchet.kz, consolidated to 24.02.2026)
up_to_3_years.evidence: в отношении автомобилей, с момента выпуска которых прошло не более 3 лет: стоимость которых не превышает 8 500 евро в эквиваленте … по единой ставке 54 процента от стоимости, но не менее 2,5 евро за 1 куб. см рабочего объема двигателя по единой ставке 48 процентов от стоимости, но не менее 3,5 евро за 1 куб. см … 48 процентов … не менее 20 евро за 1 куб. см
up_to_3_years.evidence_en: Cars up to 3 years old: value up to €8,500 → 54% but not less than €2.5/cm³; then 48% with minimums €3.5 / 5.5 / 7.5 / 15 / 20 per cm³ for values up to €16,700 / 42,300 / 84,500 / 169,000 / above.

over_3_to_5_years.applies_to: personal-use cars more than 3 and not more than 5 years old
over_3_to_5_years.source_name: RA State Revenue Committee (SRC), FAQ on customs clearance of cars, 13.12.2023 (Armenian original https://www.src.am/am/getNews/299), question 3

over_3_to_5_years.evidence_en: Cars over 3 and up to 5 years: €1.5 / 1.7 / 2.5 / 2.7 / 3 / 3.6 per cm³ for engines up to 1000 / 1500 / 1800 / 2300 / 3000 / above 3000 cm³.

over_5_years.applies_to: personal-use cars more than 5 years old

over_5_years.evidence: При растаможивании автомобилей старше 5 лет … до 1000 куб. см … х 3 евро … 1001-1500 … х 3,2 евро … 1501-1800 … х 3,5 евро … 1801-2300 … х 4,8 евро … 2301-3000 … x 5 евро … 3001 см и более … x 5,7 евро

hybrid.unit: percent of customs value, or EUR per cm³
hybrid.applies_to: commercial imports of hybrids: 8703 40 / 50 (not plug-in) and 8703 60 / 70 (plug-in)
hybrid.source_name: EAEU Common Customs Tariff (ETT, approved by EEC Council Decision No. 80 of 14.09.2021), group 87, official EEC consolidated text as of 22.01.2026
hybrid.evidence: 8703 40 603 1 … у которых мощность двигателя внутреннего сгорания больше максимальной 30- минутной мощности электрического двигателя шт 2,2 евро за 1 см3; 8703 40 603 2 – – – – – – – – прочие шт 15

conflicting_sources.source_name: SRC ExIm platform, passenger-car import payments calculator (launched 2026-04-28)
conflicting_sources.claim: The calculator never asks about power: a petrol hybrid 2000 cm³ made 2020 (business) got code 8703406034 «прочие» → 15%, i.e. it always assumes the electric motor is at least as strong.

hybrid.unsure_reason: Which branch applies needs the type-approval power figures (group 87 additional note 9). The calculator default (15%) will under-charge a hybrid whose combustion engine is stronger.
